title: Waste sorting rules
question: How must I sort my waste in Poland?
short_answer: Waste must be sorted into 5 colour-coded bins. Failure can result in higher waste fees.
conditions: Yellow bin – plastics, metal, packaging (plastik, metal)
Brown bin – bio waste, food scraps (bioodpady)
Large/hazardous items: take to PSZOK recycling centre
exceptions: Batteries: drop in designated collection boxes in shops
Electronics: take to PSZOK or authorised shop
Building debris: contact municipality for collection
penalties: Municipalities can charge 2x the standard waste fee for unsorted waste
